detail.longDescription:
i just saw an example of a ChatGPT log - the prompts and responses used to get  it to generate something - for the first time ever.  Keep in mind that i have never used an LLM before, so this is brand new to me and the experience is mind boggling.  i pasted the log into my word processor for easier reading after it was emailed to me.  It's 23 pages long.  That's a lot of back and forth with ChatGPT if you ask me, and what was it for?

The final output from the LLM was literally just 1 1/2 pages of text.

How can someone think they are benefitting from so called AI when they spend 15 times as much effort to produce the output?  Also, the analysis and summary that ChatGPT produced contains a lot of errors, even to the point of getting names wrong.

You know what's even worse?  i prefer what my friend wrote herself when prompting ChatGPT to the output that ChatGPT came up with.

#AI #LLM #ChatGPT
